no_third_party_assertions: All E1-E6 renderings are original works generated by the declared AI agents. No third-party logos, trademarks, real portraits, or copyrighted artwork are embedded.
Figures derived from public Esri satellite imagery are for concept-level planning visualization only, not surveying.
Brand names in narrative text (JZ-IA, Ren-shape motif, etc.) are concept-level proposals, not registered trademarks.

All numeric figures in proposal text are either provisional (derived from submitted provisional geometry) or conceptual planning targets. No data is presented with 'high confidence' on official approval status (see metrics.json).
